text:
jess: Observed a spike of SSO failures from EU customers after the metadata sync at 09:12 UTC. Error: 'Invalid XML charset' in our SAML parser. :warning:
omar: Confirmed. Stack trace shows parser choking on a BOM in the IdP metadata blob.
liam: Which IdP? Okta? Azure?
sara: Affected tenants are mixed (Okta + custom ADFS). I pulled the raw metadata from the cache.
jess: Pasted snippet:
```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- weird leading BOM bytes present -->
<md:EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.example.com">
```
omar: Parser expects UTF-8 without BOM. BOM causes java XMLInputFactory to throw.
liam: Could be our metadata-fetcher collapsing whitespace and re-encoding. I saw a recent change to stream->buffer conversion in metadata-fetcher v2.1.3
sara: Also seeing SCIM failures for same tenants: provisioning requests return 400 with 'malformed header'. Possibly the same re-encoding path touches provisioning service when we proxy metadata <-> tenant config.
jess: KMS logs show a few decrypt errors around the same time but only for service-account keys used by metadata-fetcher: "decrypt: org not found" — might be fallout from invalid metadata update loop.
infra-bot: deploy-rollback suggested for metadata-fetcher:v2.1.3 (canary) — 3/5 failures on canary hosts.
omar: Immediate remediation options:
- revert metadata-fetcher change (fast rollback)
- strip BOM on ingest as a hotfix
- add tolerant XML parser fallback
liam: I can push a small hotfix to strip BOM and retry parsing. Low risk. Will run on canary first.
sara: We also need an incident ticket and audit annotations. Can someone open INC-1799 and add tenant list + sample metadata blobs?
jess: I opened INC-1799 and attached the sample. Link: https://inc.redwood/INC-1799
omar: For root cause postmortem: check why upstream IdPs sent BOMs and whether our fetcher altered encoding. Add KMS decrypt failures correlation too.
liam: Hotfix PR created: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/metadata-fetcher/pulls/42 — patch strips leading BOM bytes and logs original blob to s3/safe-audit (redacted PII).
jess: Can we also add an audit log entry when metadata is accepted vs rejected? Need compliance trace.
sara: Agree — add an 'idp_metadata.validation' event to audit logs with result, checksum, and key-hash (no PII) — I'll file follow-up.
infra-bot: canary rollout scheduled, 5-minute window, health checks on SSO auth success metric.
omar: After canary looks good, plan full rollback of v2.1.3 if issues persist.
liam: Deploying canary patch now.
sara: Noted — I've alerted support to hold tenant-facing change notices until we confirm.
jess: Thanks team. Will update INC-1799 with timeline and next steps. :lock:
idp-bot: alert cleared for tenants T-145 and T-188 after canary patch successful on 2 hosts.
jess: follow-ups: postmortem, audit event, KMS decrypt correlation, check metadata fetcher streaming change review.
